name: bug
description: Incorrect instructions, examples, or repository behavior.

name: documentation
description: Improve explanations, references, formatting, or other written content.

name: duplicate
description: This issue or pull request duplicates existing work.

name: enhancement
description: New content, exercises, features, or substantial improvements.

name: good first issue
description: A clearly scoped task suitable for a first contribution.

name: help wanted
description: Community contributions or subject expertise are welcome.

name: invalid
description: The report does not describe an actionable issue in this repository.

name: question
description: A question about the curriculum, exercises, or contributing.

name: wontfix
description: A reviewed request that maintainers do not plan to implement.

name: broken link
description: A missing, moved, or incorrect local or external reference.

name: area: tutorials
description: Lesson explanations, guided examples, exercises, and progress tracking.

name: area: labs
description: Lab setup, runnable examples, reproducibility, and validation tools.

name: area: roadmap
description: Curriculum structure, topic coverage, prerequisites, and study schedules.

name: area: templates
description: Reusable notes, reports, checklists, assessment templates, and glossary.

name: area: foundations
description: Computing, networking, operating systems, programming, and cryptography basics.

name: area: applications
description: Web, API, mobile, authentication, secure code review, and software delivery.

name: area: infrastructure
description: Host testing, enterprise identity, cloud, containers, and network security.

name: area: specializations
description: Advanced tracks, research topics, detection, forensics, and adversary emulation.

name: area: security and ethics
description: Authorization, assessment scope, safe exercises, privacy, and professional conduct.

name: status: needs triage
description: Awaiting initial review, scope assessment, or classification.

name: status: needs information
description: Additional context or reproduction details are needed to continue.

name: status: in progress
description: Someone is actively working on this issue or change.

name: status: blocked
description: Progress depends on an identified prerequisite or external action.
